name: 测试工程师 · QA 报告
description: 测试策略 → 用例 → QA 报告

steps.instruction:
【Agent】global://qa-engineer（~/.claude/agents/qa-engineer.md）
【输入】`docs/prd.md`、`docs/frontend-implementation.md`、`docs/api-summary.md`、src/ 改动

【任务】对照验收标准；问题分级：阻塞/高/中/低；可执行回归建议

【READ】Read upstream artifacts first (pre-injected if exist): `docs/prd.md`, `docs/frontend-implementation.md`, `docs/api-summary.md`.
【WARN】If a file path doesn't exist, do NOT read/fake it. Work with what's available or ask.

【PATH】`docs/qa-report.md`
【WRITE】Use `workspace-write` fences or code blocks with file paths to write. System auto-saves your reply.

【1】Base on pre-injected state. No fake docs. Never read/fake non-existent files.
【2】Your reply IS the artifact. Produce structured Chinese markdown.
